title: Fleet import with spares cues
goal: `nerv fleet import FILE.json` loads a whole fleet at once and every installed component model becomes a spares record
acceptance: Strict JSON shape { version: 1, drones: [ { name, frame?, notes?, parts: [ { category, model, positions? } ] } ] }; errors name the bad field
A part with positions creates one part row per position; without positions, one row at "main"
Every distinct component model gets a spares record at 0 new and 0 used, category from the part
Idempotent: an existing drone keeps its row and parts, an existing spares record keeps its counts; the report lists created vs already present
privacy: Owner fleet data stays local-only; tests use invented drones and generic parts.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Owner decision 2026-11-23 added this step; estimated 0.5 h at agent speed for one parser, one store method and a CLI branch. Not a measurement.
